why: Counts the clears jsdom's focus setter makes too, so every focus move empties the cache, which is exactly the jsdom 30.1.2 cost the cache exists to remove (issue #1093). Nothing reads stale, so only the cases that assert a read after a focus move is still a hit, with no invalidation, can see it.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: a focus move keeps the cache serves display from the cache across a focus, a second focus and a blur, though jsdom empties its own on each
computed-style-cache: what a hit returns reads every property but display fresh, so a :focus color shows after a focus move
